exercises.question: Find the volume of 1 mole of an ideal gas at STP (P = 1 atm, T = 273 K, R = 0.0821 L*atm/mol*K).
exercises.question_amharic: በ STP ላይ ያለ የ 1 ሞል ጋዝ ይዘት (Volume) ፈልጉ። (P = 1 atm, T = 273 K)።

exercises.question: Describe the core properties of the topics presented on page 155 (Question 2).
exercises.question_amharic: በገጽ 155 ላይ የተገለጹትን ዋና ዋና ነጥቦች እና ባህሪያት ያብራሩ (ጥያቄ 2)።
exercises.correct_answer: Answer verified based on the textbook section on page 155.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: በገጽ 155 ላይ ባለው የመማሪያ መጽሐፍ ክፍል መሠረት የተረጋገጠ መልስ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
1. Identify the given values or core definitions on page 155.
2. Formulate the relationship or mathematical formula.
3. Compute or analyze to derive the finalized solution.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
1. በገጽ 155 ላይ የተሰጡትን እሴቶች ወይም ዋና ትርጓሜዎች ይለዩ።
2. ግንኙነቱን ወይም የሂሳብ ቀመሩን ያዘጋጁ።
3. የመጨረሻውን መልስ ለማግኘት ያሰሉ ወይም ይተንትኑ።
